items.quote: I have ruled out using ALP.

items.rationale: Parquet column statistics are not used by Iceberg and add significant overhead to write operations.
items.title: Disable Parquet stats for vector columns
items.statement: Parquet column statistics should be disabled for vector columns to improve write performance.
items.quote: to speed up writes, I turned off Parquet stats for vector columns. Iceberg doesn't use them, and they cost up to ~30% of write time.

items.title: Vector type as primitive in Iceberg
items.statement: The Iceberg vector type is treated as a primitive type, despite Parquet's nested representation.
items.quote: treating Iceberg vectors as a primitive type felt natural.

items.title: Puffin currently supports only Theta sketch for NDV
items.statement: Puffin currently defines only one blob type for NDV statistics: apache-datasketches-theta-v1.
items.quote: Puffin currently defines only one blob type for NDV statistics, apache-datasketches-theta-v1.

items.quote: In some workloads, Theta sketch computation is slow. In Trino, it causes a 10-20% slowdown on inserts.

items.rationale: Explains the root cause of the bug where non-key column stats in equality delete files lead to incorrect pruning.
items.title: Equality delete file stats bug
items.statement: Non-key column stats in equality delete files can cause incorrect predicate pruning, leaving undeleted rows in query results.
items.quote: columns outside the equality key might carry null or sentinel values. The ManifestReader has been treating these non-key column stats as reliable for metrics pruning. Consequently, certain predicates (like col IS NOT NULL) can incorrectly skip valid delete manifest entries, leaving rows in the query result that should have been deleted

items.rationale: Describes the current behavior of Flink in non-upsert mode regarding equality delete file stats.
items.title: Flink non-upsert mode stats
items.statement: In non-upsert mode, Flink collects stats for all columns in equality delete files, including non-key columns.
items.quote: The column stats are indeed collected by Flink in non-upsert mode. (In that mode the equality delete row schema is the full table schema, and the delete writer uses the table's metrics config. So non-key columns get value/null counts and lower/upper bounds.)

items.rationale: Proposed rule to avoid storing non-key column stats in equality delete files to prevent misuse.
items.title: Avoid storing non-key stats
items.statement: Stats for columns not in equality_ids should not be stored for equality delete files.
items.quote: I'd suggest changing the spec to say: "Stats for columns not in equality_ids should not be stored for equality delete files."

items.rationale: Consensus that equality deletes are being phased out, with v4 already forbidding them.
items.title: Equality deletes phased out
items.statement: Equality deletes are being phased out, and v4 format tables already forbid them.
